storyline.real: Schumacher hits the wall and the two collide on lap 36; both retire and Schumacher takes the title by one point
storyline.headline: Schumacher's first title, settled at the flag

eras.briefing: Adelaide, 1994, the final round. Schumacher leads the championship on 92 points, Hill is one behind on 91. One point between them, one race left. Mansell started from pole. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt to fit the result, the fastest laps and the sourced stops (Jolpica, F1DB, Motor Sport, Wikipedia). The lap-by-lap gaps and running order are synthetic, not history.
